lines.say: So, we'll launch the new menu next Monday. Everyone happy?
lines.zh: 那我們下週一推出新菜單，大家都沒問題吧？

lines.say: Em… yeah. Grand.
lines.zh: 呃……對，沒問題。

lines.say: I knew Monday was a bad idea. Half the team was on holiday. But I said nothing, because disagreeing in English felt rude.
lines.zh: 我知道週一不行，一半的人在休假。但我什麼都沒說，因為用英文反對感覺很沒禮貌。

lines.say: Monday came, and it was a disaster. And someone asked me: why didn't you say something?
lines.zh: 週一到了，一場災難。然後有人問我：你怎麼不早說？

board.cta: 開會時禮貌地不同意・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for disagreeing in a meeting.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你開會時表達不同意見的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for disagreeing in a meeting.

lines.say: Disagreeing isn't rude. Doing it badly is. Today you'll learn to do it well.
lines.zh: 反對不等於沒禮貌，反對得不好才是。今天教你怎麼反對得漂亮。

scenes.title: Get in
scenes.sub: 插話：先拿到說話的機會

lines.say: Part one: get in.
lines.zh: 第一段：插話。

lines.say: In a fast meeting, nobody will stop and ask for your opinion. You have to step in.
lines.zh: 節奏快的會議，沒有人會停下來問你意見。你得自己切進去。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Sorry to jump in, but could I just add something?
scenes.meaning: 抱歉插個話，我可以補充一下嗎？

lines.say: Sorry to jump in, but could I just add something?
Jump in means start talking while others are talking.
lines.zh: jump in 是在別人講話時切進來。

lines.say: Sorry to jump in, plus just. Two small softeners, and nobody minds.
lines.zh: Sorry to jump in 再加上 just，兩個小緩衝，就沒人介意。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry to jump in, but could I just add something?

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Before we move on, can I go back to the launch date?
scenes.meaning: 在進入下一項之前，我可以回到推出日期嗎？

lines.say: If the topic already passed, bring it back.
lines.zh: 如果話題已經過去了，就把它拉回來。

lines.say: Before we move on, can I go back to the launch date?
Move on means go to the next point.
lines.zh: move on 是換到下一個議題。

lines.say: Before we move on is perfect timing. It's not too late yet.
lines.zh: Before we move on 時機剛好，還不算太晚。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Before we move on, can I go back to the launch date?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Can I play devil's advocate for a second?
scenes.note: play devil's advocate ＝ 故意提出反方意見

lines.say: And here's a clever one when everyone already agrees.
lines.zh: 大家都已經同意的時候，有一招很聰明。

lines.say: Can I play devil's advocate for a second?
To play devil's advocate means to argue the other side, just to test the idea.
lines.zh: play devil's advocate 是故意站在反方，測試這個想法。

lines.say: It's safe, because you're not saying you're against it. You're just being careful.
lines.zh: 這很安全，因為你沒說你反對，只是在謹慎檢查。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Can I play devil's advocate for a second?

scenes.title: Disagree
scenes.sub: 表達不同意：先認同，再轉折

lines.say: Part two: disagree.
lines.zh: 第二段：表達不同意。

lines.say: The secret is a sandwich: something positive, then your concern.
lines.zh: 秘訣是三明治：先講好的，再講你的擔心。

items: ✓ I see what you mean, but…

lines.say: That's wrong, or that won't work, closes the conversation.
lines.zh: 說 That's wrong 或 That won't work，對話就結束了。

lines.say: Start by showing you understand. Then add your but.
lines.zh: 先表示你理解，再接 but。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure Monday works.
scenes.meaning: 我懂你的出發點，但我不確定週一可行
scenes.note: where you're coming from ＝ 你的出發點

lines.say: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure Monday works.
I see where you're coming from means I understand why you think that.
lines.zh: I see where you're coming from 是我懂你為什麼這樣想。

lines.say: And I'm not sure is much softer than no. But everyone understands it means no.
lines.zh: I'm not sure 比 no 柔和得多，但大家都聽得懂意思是不行。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure Monday works.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: My concern is that half the team will be on leave.
scenes.meaning: 我擔心的是一半的人在休假
scenes.note: My concern is that ＝ 我擔心的是

lines.say: Then give the real reason. Make it about the problem, not the person.
lines.zh: 接著講真正的原因。針對問題，不針對人。

lines.say: My concern is that half the team will be on leave.
My concern is that turns a complaint into a careful, professional point.
lines.zh: My concern is that 把抱怨變成謹慎、專業的意見。

lines.say: On leave means on holiday from work.
lines.zh: on leave 是請假、休假中。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: My concern is that half the team will be on leave.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I'm not convinced we have enough time to train everyone.
scenes.meaning: 我不太相信我們有足夠時間訓練所有人
scenes.note: I'm not convinced ＝ 我不太認同、沒被說服

lines.say: And if you need a stronger line, use this.
lines.zh: 需要更強烈一點時，用這一句。

lines.say: I'm not convinced we have enough time to train everyone.
I'm not convinced means: you haven't persuaded me yet.
lines.zh: I'm not convinced 是「你還沒說服我」。

lines.say: It leaves the door open. Give me a good reason, and I might change my mind.
lines.zh: 它把門留著：給我好理由，我可能會改變主意。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm not convinced we have enough time to train everyone.
Watch how I try again.
lines.zh: 看我重新來一次。

lines.say: So, we'll launch next Monday. Everyone happy?
lines.zh: 那我們下週一推出，大家都沒問題吧？

lines.say: Sorry to jump in, but could I just add something?
lines.zh: 抱歉插個話，我可以補充一下嗎？

lines.say: Sure, go ahead.
lines.zh: 當然，請說。

lines.say: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure Monday works. My concern is that half the team will be on leave.
lines.zh: 我懂你的出發點，但我不確定週一可行。我擔心的是一半的人在休假。

lines.say: Oh. I hadn't thought of that.
lines.zh: 喔，我沒想到這點。

lines.say: Nobody was offended, and the problem is on the table.
lines.zh: 沒有人被冒犯，而且問題被提出來了。

scenes.title: Offer a way
scenes.sub: 提方案：不只說不，還要說怎麼做

lines.say: Part three: offer a way forward.
lines.zh: 第三段：提出替代方案。

lines.say: A no without a plan sounds negative. A no with a plan sounds like leadership.
lines.zh: 只有反對沒有方案，聽起來很負面。有方案的反對，聽起來像領導者。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: What if we pushed it back a week?

lines.say: What if we pushed it back a week?
Push back means move to a later date.
lines.zh: push back 是把日期往後延。

lines.say: What if we, with the past form pushed, sounds like an idea, not a demand.
lines.zh: What if we 加上過去式 pushed，聽起來像建議，不像要求。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What if we pushed it back a week?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: Would it make more sense to start with one shop first?
scenes.meaning: 先從一家店開始，會不會比較合理？
scenes.note: make more sense ＝ 比較合理

lines.say: Or suggest a smaller step.
lines.zh: 或是建議先走一小步。

lines.say: Would it make more sense to start with one shop first?
Make more sense means be more logical.
lines.zh: make more sense 是比較合理。

lines.say: Asking it as a question lets the others decide. People love deciding.
lines.zh: 用問句提出，讓大家自己決定。人都喜歡自己做決定。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Would it make more sense to start with one shop first?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: I'd be happy to look into it and come back to you on Friday.
scenes.meaning: 我很樂意研究一下，星期五再回覆你們
scenes.note: look into ＝ 研究、調查　come back to you ＝ 回覆你

lines.say: And offer to do the work. That makes your idea easy to accept.
lines.zh: 再主動接下工作，讓你的意見很容易被接受。

lines.say: I'd be happy to look into it and come back to you on Friday.
Look into it means check it carefully. Come back to you means give you an answer later.
lines.zh: look into 是仔細研究，come back to you 是之後回覆你。

lines.say: Now you're not the person who complains. You're the person who solves it.
lines.zh: 現在你不是抱怨的人，而是解決問題的人。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'd be happy to look into it and come back to you on Friday.
Part four: land it.
lines.zh: 第四段：收尾。

lines.say: You don't have to win everything. Agree where you can.
lines.zh: 你不用每一點都贏。能同意的地方就同意。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Fair point. I hadn't looked at it that way.
scenes.meaning: 說得好，我之前沒從這個角度想

lines.say: Fair point. I hadn't looked at it that way.
Fair point means: that's a good argument.
lines.zh: fair point 是你這點說得有道理。

lines.say: Saying this when someone is right makes people trust you when you disagree.
lines.zh: 別人說得對時大方承認，你反對時大家才會信你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Fair point. I hadn't looked at it that way.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: I can live with that, as long as we review it after a month.
scenes.meaning: 我可以接受，只要一個月後再檢討
scenes.note: I can live with that ＝ 我可以接受

lines.say: And when you accept, but not completely, say this.
lines.zh: 接受但還有條件時，這樣說。

lines.say: I can live with that, as long as we review it after a month.
I can live with that means it's not perfect, but I accept it.
lines.zh: I can live with that 是不完美，但我能接受。

lines.say: Review means look at it again and check it's working.
lines.zh: review 是之後再檢查一次效果。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I can live with that, as long as we review it after a month.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: So, just so we're all clear: launch on the twentieth, one shop first.
scenes.meaning: 所以讓大家都清楚：二十號推出，先從一家店開始
scenes.note: just so we're all clear ＝ 讓大家都清楚

lines.say: And finish by saying the decision out loud.
lines.zh: 最後把決定大聲說一遍。

lines.say: So, just so we're all clear: launch on the twentieth, one shop first.
Just so we're all clear means let's make sure everyone understood the same thing.
lines.zh: just so we're all clear 是確認大家理解一致。

lines.say: Meetings fail when everyone leaves with a different plan in their head.
lines.zh: 很多會議失敗，是因為每個人帶著不同的計畫離開。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: So, just so we're all clear: launch on the twentieth, one shop first.
What if we pushed it back a week? Would it make more sense to start with one shop first?
lines.zh: 如果我們延後一週呢？先從一家店開始，會不會比較合理？

lines.say: But we promised the owners a big launch.
lines.zh: 可是我們跟老闆保證要盛大推出。

lines.say: Fair point. I hadn't looked at it that way.
lines.zh: 說得好，我之前沒從這個角度想。

lines.say: OK. One shop on the twentieth, then all shops a week later?
lines.zh: 好吧。二十號先一家店，一週後全部的店？

lines.say: I can live with that.
lines.zh: 我可以接受。

lines.say: Great. Thanks for speaking up.
lines.zh: 太好了，謝謝你提出來。

lines.say: Thanks for speaking up. That's what you want to hear.
lines.zh: 謝謝你提出來。這就是你想聽到的話。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：會議裡的兩句話

lines.say: One more thing! Two things you'll hear in an Irish meeting.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！在愛爾蘭開會會聽到的兩句話。

big: *I'd be a bit wary of that.

lines.say: Irish people rarely say an idea is bad. They say this.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人很少直接說點子很爛，他們會這樣說。

lines.say: I'd be a bit wary of that.
Wary means careful, a bit worried. But a bit wary often means: absolutely not!
lines.zh: wary 是謹慎、有點擔心。但「有點保留」常常代表：絕對不行！

lines.say: And this is how many Irish meetings end.
lines.zh: 很多愛爾蘭會議都是這樣結束的。

lines.say: Grand, so.
It means: OK, we're done, decision made. Then everyone goes for tea.
lines.zh: 意思是：好，結束，決定了。然後大家去喝茶。

lines.say: Grand, so!
Let's go back to that first meeting. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們回到第一場會議。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: So, we'll launch the new menu next Monday. Everyone happy?
lines.zh: 那我們下週一推出新菜單，大家都沒問題吧？

lines.say: Before we move on, can I go back to the launch date?
lines.zh: 在進入下一項之前，我可以回到推出日期嗎？

lines.say: Sure.
lines.zh: 當然。

lines.say: I'm not convinced we have enough time to train everyone. I'd be happy to look into it and come back to you on Friday.
lines.zh: 我不太相信我們有足夠時間訓練所有人。我很樂意研究一下，星期五再回覆你們。

lines.say: Perfect. Let's do that.
lines.zh: 很好，就這麼辦。

lines.say: So, just so we're all clear: no launch until Friday's update.
lines.zh: 所以讓大家都清楚：星期五報告之前先不推出。

lines.say: Grand, so.
lines.zh: 好，就這樣吧。

items: Sorry to jump in, but could I just add something?
Before we move on, can I go back to the launch date?
Can I play devil's advocate for a second?
I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure Monday works.
My concern is that half the team will be on leave.
I'm not convinced we have enough time to train everyone.
What if we pushed it back a week?
Would it make more sense to start with one shop first?
I'd be happy to look into it and come back to you on Friday.
Fair point. I hadn't looked at it that way.
I can live with that, as long as we review it after a month.
So, just so we're all clear: launch on the twentieth, one shop first.

lines.say: You spoke up, nobody was offended, and the plan got better. Brilliant!
lines.zh: 你開口了、沒人被冒犯，計畫還變得更好。太棒了！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before your next meeting.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，下次開會前先截圖。

items: 📰 每天一則在地新聞練英文
🎮 單字小遊戲，約朋友一起玩
🔥 連續打卡、解鎖稱號、逛廣場
🎓 英文小教室：會話、片語、文法

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: Any questions? No? Grand, so. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 有問題嗎？沒有？好，就這樣吧。下一課見，Bye！
